query: How can a customer request a refund and return an order?

documents.title: Customer refund procedure
documents.chunk_text: Customers request a refund by opening a return case within thirty days.
documents.source_text: The approved return policy is the governing source for refund requests.

documents.title: Security incident response
documents.chunk_text: Security incidents are escalated to the incident response team.
documents.source_text: The security policy defines incident severity and escalation.
